description.describe_ch: 本課程以因應建築教育改革計畫中提出專業英語教學與國際化接軌，授課內容英語教學與建築學專業培養相結合，加強建築學專業英語之實際應用能力。
description.describe_eh: he course to cope with architecture education reform plan proposed the construction of professional and international standards of English teaching. English teaching course content combined with training in architecture, to enhance the practical application of architecture professional ability in English.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
教室內禁止吃東西。
任何打擾到其他同學聽講學習的行為都會遭到警告。
授課不使用麥克風，鼓勵同學盡量選擇靠近講台的座位。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Policies
No eating allowed in classroom.
Any action jeopardizing others from learning will be warned.
Lecture does not use microphone, encourage students to sit closer to front of classroom.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
抄襲與被抄襲，都是0分的待遇。
因為大班授課，依據課程內容安排，實質同學之間的課堂互動，有其先天限制。
課程內容以分享為主，並且期望啟發同學後續之自主探索，深入學習。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Works involving plagiarism, both copied and copying will result in a zero score, grade F.
Class material is based on knowledge sharing from instructor, aim to inspire students to further explore topics mentioned in class.  Given current class size, it is difficult to instigate frequent interaction and English practice with each individual.
